profile.Education: Doctor of Science (DSc) — Plant Biology and Regenerative Sciences, University of Edinburgh, Scotland, United Kingdom. (Awarded on 2018)
profile.Strengths: Advanced Earth magic, healing, magical research, experimentation, adaptability, observation, patience, teaching, and extensive knowledge of Guardian Cores.
profile.Weaknesses: Verdant's curiosity sometimes causes her to become deeply involved in investigating unusual phenomena. Her determination to uncover the truth can lead her to underestimate how far someone might go to conceal their actions. Although an experienced Guardian, her healing abilities do not make her immune to capture, restraint, or prolonged magical suppression.
profile.Fear: Her research or discoveries being used to harm innocent people, and being unable to protect the disciples she has guided.
profile.Disciple: Luma Woodland, Luma Harvest, Luma Seed, Luma Briar, Luma Fern, Luma Funga, Luma Flora, Luma Blossom; Luma Lotus (secretly awakened during captivity, not officially registered under her)
profile.Relationship: Widow; husband was a civilian who passed away from natural causes centuries ago. Has remained single since
profile.Family: Former Husband & Children (deceased); Currently watching over descendants from afar.
profile.Close bonds: Luma Life, Luma Cedar, Luma Blossom, Luma Flora / EmberFlora
profile.Rivals: Luma Mineral (friendly academic rival); Luma Yew / Blightyou (enemy)
profile.Loves: Discovering new magical possibilities, teaching her disciples, watching them develop unique abilities, and seeing her research improve the lives of others.
profile.Likes: Magical experimentation, unusual Guardian abilities, botanical research, asking questions, learning from unexpected results, and encouraging creative approaches to magic.
profile.Dislikes: Unnecessary restrictions on harmless experimentation, discouraging curiosity, dismissing unusual abilities as useless, and research being conducted without proper consideration for others.
profile.Hates: Using Guardians as experimental subjects without consent, exploiting vulnerable people, forbidden Core manipulation, and deliberately harming disciples.
profile.Hobbies: Gardening, studying unusual plants, conducting magical experiments, maintaining research journals, and inventing new applications for Earth magic.
profile.Personality: Verdant is curious, enthusiastic, and highly experimental, with a strong passion for discovering new applications of Guardian magic. She actively encourages her disciples to experiment with their abilities rather than restricting themselves to conventional techniques, believing that every Core has its own individuality and potential. Although she enjoys observing unusual results and occasionally becomes overly excited by new discoveries, she takes safety and her responsibilities as a mentor seriously. Verdant is patient with mistakes and prefers helping her disciples understand why something failed instead of discouraging them from trying again. Her teaching style promotes creativity, adaptability, and independent thinking, allowing her disciples to develop abilities that differ significantly from their original elemental roots. Despite her cheerful curiosity, Verdant is an experienced and perceptive Guardian who becomes serious when she recognises danger, especially when her research involves the safety of other Guardians.
Personality Example: Verdant asks her disciples to perform a familiar technique in an entirely different way. When they question whether it is possible, she responds enthusiastically, "That's what we're going to find out!"

When Lumina struggles to produce conventional Fire magic, Verdant encourages her to explore the unusual interactions between Fire and Earth instead of forcing her abilities to resemble those of other Fire Guardians.

Verdant frequently brings unusual plants or experimental materials into training sessions, occasionally causing Sylvia and Lumina to question whether they are attending a lesson or participating in another research project.

Despite encouraging experimentation, she immediately stops an exercise when a disciple approaches their Core's limits, explaining that discovering what magic cannot safely do is also an important result.
profile.Fever Behaviour: Verdant becomes unusually absent-minded and easily distracted when feverish. Her normally curious and experimental nature remains, but her thoughts become increasingly scattered, causing her to ramble about unfinished experiments or come up with ridiculous theories. She occasionally attempts to conduct experiments despite being visibly unwell and becomes frustrated when others confiscate her equipment or force her to rest.
profile.Intoxicated Behaviour: Verdant becomes extremely affectionate and loses all sense of personal boundaries when intoxicated. She enthusiastically hugs everyone within reach and frequently attempts to kiss them directly on the lips, regardless of whether they are male or female. She becomes completely shameless about expressing her affection, making her someone others instinctively avoid whenever alcohol is involved. Once she spots someone she wants to shower with affection, escaping her enthusiastic advances becomes a challenge.
profile.Core Idea of character: A mentor who believes every Core deserves the freedom to discover its own potential.
Quotes: "Just because nobody has done it before doesn't mean it can't be done."
"A failed experiment isn't a waste. Now we know one more thing that doesn't work."
profile.Background:
Luma Verdant is a centuries-old Earth Guardian specialising in healing and magical research. As a mentor, she strongly encourages experimentation and individuality, guiding disciples such as Cedar, Flora, and Blossom to explore their powers beyond conventional applications. Her teachings helped shape creative magical techniques that are later demonstrated by Blossom and Flora.
Rather than relying only on instinct, Verdant carefully documents her discoveries in a large collection of grimoires. These grimoires contain years of research notes, sketches, observations, power theories, healing methods, plant studies, and records of unusual magical phenomena. Some focus on botanical life and the behaviour of magical plants, while others study Guardian cores, elemental traces, inherited powers, and how different branches may develop over time.
While researching Resonance crystals, she found suspicious leads connecting to the death of Luma Cedar, Verdant began uncovering information about Blightyou. On 5 May 2021, the day Lumina and Sylvia were due to attend their polytechnic graduation, she was captured by Blightyou and subsequently reported missing.
During her captivity, Blightyou became particularly interested in Blossom's unusual Fire Core, which had inherited Earth through Verdant's awakening, resembling his own dual-element condition. His interest intensified after Flora evolved into EmberFlora in October 2025, demonstrating another successful case of Fire inheritance. Determined to continue his research, Blightyou kept Verdant imprisoned, providing her with food and basic necessities while refusing to release her.
In 2026, Blightyou brought an unsuspecting Adrian Koh to his lair and introduced Verdant as a fellow researcher who was ill and quarantined. Unaware of the truth, Adrian was secretly awakened by Verdant, inheriting Earth magic alongside his natural Water element. He later became Luma Lotus, while the circumstances of his awakening remained hidden from the Guardian system.
